questions.title: Exact replication and audit of the published Trimmed Match example-dataset generator
questions.description: Conduct an L1 exact published-source replication of the example-dataset generator accompanying Chen and Au, Annals of Applied Statistics 16(1):1-20, 2022, using only the operator-supplied hash-bound paper and repository snapshot and operator-pinned execution. Inspect the paper context, README, exact simulation_script.py entrypoint, design and post-analysis guides, repository metadata, license, and independent environment lock. Run the pinned source without editing, wrapping, or replacing it. In one durable Markdown report, record the source snapshot, execution-manifest, repository-commit, entrypoint, arguments, environment, and both result-artifact identities. Describe what the entrypoint actually generates, including each CSV's path, schema, row count, date coverage, geo count, and the post-analysis pair and assignment structure. Audit the relationship between the num_geos flag and observed outputs, how pairing and assignment are constructed, and any compatibility warnings or unused protocol elements visible in source. Distinguish this exact dataset-generation rerun from execution or validation of the Trimmed Match estimator, reproduction of a paper table or figure, confirmatory empirical evidence, a performance comparison, or theorem proof. No model-authored estimator, replacement simulation, novelty claim, or Lean formalization is required. Disclose all remaining reproducibility, environment, interpretation, source-identity, and scientific-scope gaps honestly.

source.paper_title: Robust Causal Inference for Incremental Return on Ad Spend with Randomized Paired Geo Experiments
